description: This file defines a Python class Ui_prefDialog that sets up a user interface for preferences using PySide6 (Qt for Python). It includes various settings tabs for project options, observations, plugins, FFmpeg, spectrogram/waveform, plot colors, and interface customization, generated from a Qt Designer .ui file.

classes.name: Ui_prefDialog
classes.description: A class that constructs the preferences dialog UI layout and widgets, including methods setupUi() for building the UI and retranslateUi() for setting translatable text.

methods.name: setupUi(self, prefDialog)
methods.description: Initializes and configures the UI components for the preferences dialog, including layouts, widgets, and tabs.

methods.name: retranslateUi(self, prefDialog)
methods.description: Sets the display text for UI components, supporting internationalization.
